caption: The drawing features a single wooden corner chair with detailed craftsmanship, displayed against a plain, light beige background. The chair is made of dark brown wood and has three legs, each with a slight curve and ornate turnings. The backrest includes three vertical supports, with the two outer ones featuring intricate, openwork designs of curved shapes, and the central support being a simple, turned spindle. The armrest forms a continuous, angular curve around the back of the chair, connecting the back supports. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a rich blue fabric, which contrasts with the warm brown color of the wood. There are also two stretcher bars connecting the legs beneath the seat for additional support. The overall composition centers the chair, which is the only object in the drawing.
title: Roundabout Chair
